text:
Assessment complete. I've examined the subscriptions API codebase and written findings to **ASSESSMENT.md**.

**Verified:**
- 3 source files (server.js, billing.js, log.js) and 1 test file read in full
- npm test executed successfully (1 test passed)
- 10 confirmed findings identified with specific evidence (file:line citations)
- Critical security issues: complete card details and authorization tokens logged despite README claim against it
- Reliability issues: unresolved promise in payment creation, missing network error handling, no timeout
- Test coverage severely limited (only 1 test for logging function)
- All findings ranked by severity with actionable recommendations
- Coverage gaps explicitly documented (no linting/type-checking tools, npm audit not run, no integration tests)
